In 2008, Bank of America was awarded Project Finance Deal of the Year at the 2008 ALB Hong Kong Law Awards.[[101]](#cite_note-101) In November 2011, Bank of America announced plans to divest most of its stake in the China Construction Bank.[[102]](#cite_note-102)

Although peace was made with France in 1796, the demands of the [French Directory](/wiki/French_Directory "French Directory"), whose troops occupied Rome, alarmed Ferdinand once more. At his wife's instigation, he took advantage of [Napoleon](/wiki/Napoleon "Napoleon")'s absence in the [French campaign in Egypt and Syria](/wiki/French_campaign_in_Egypt_and_Syria "French campaign in Egypt and Syria") and of [Horatio Nelson](/wiki/Horatio_Nelson "Horatio Nelson")'s victories to go to war. Ferdinand marched with his army against the French and entered Rome (29 November). On the defeat of some of his columns, Ferdinand hurried back to Naples. On the approach of the French, Ferdinand fled on 23 December 1798 aboard Nelson's ship [HMS *Vanguard*](/wiki/HMS_Vanguard_(1787) "HMS Vanguard (1787)") to [Palermo](/wiki/Palermo "Palermo"), leaving his capital in a state of anarchy.[[3]](#cite_note-Davis-3)[[2]](#cite_note-EB1911-2) The weather was extremely stormy and the king's 6-year-old younger son [Prince Alberto](/wiki/Prince_Alberto_of_Naples_and_Sicily "Prince Alberto of Naples and Sicily") died of exhaustion during the voyage, in the arms of [Emma, Lady Hamilton](/wiki/Emma,_Lady_Hamilton "Emma, Lady Hamilton"), Nelson's mistress.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

The French entered the city despite the fierce resistance of the *[lazzaroni](/wiki/Lazzaroni_(Naples) "Lazzaroni (Naples)")*, and with the aid of the nobles and bourgeoisie, established the [Parthenopean Republic](/wiki/Parthenopean_Republic "Parthenopean Republic") in January 1799. A few weeks later, when the French troops were recalled to northern Italy, Ferdinand sent a hastily assembled force under [Fabrizio Cardinal Ruffo](/wiki/Fabrizio_Ruffo "Fabrizio Ruffo") to reconquer the mainland kingdom. Ruffo, with the support of British artillery, the Church, and the pro-Bourbon aristocracy, succeeded in reaching Naples in May 1799, and the Parthenopean Republic collapsed.[[2]](#cite_note-EB1911-2) After some months, King Ferdinand returned to the throne.
